title: Fabtech Cleanrooms Ltd - 544332 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cleanroom contractor FY26 standalone EBITDA fell 21.5% to 12.96 cr and PAT fell 24.75% to 9.06 cr; management attributes this to deliberately thin margins on new solar, data-centre and semicon orders, with order book of about 199 cr.
